presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch activity with Trakt using a community-maintained plugin.
presentation.description_markdown: Community fork of the archived Silo Trakt plugin. Imports watched movies and episodes, resume progress, favorites, the watchlist, movie and show ratings, and dropped shows from Trakt. Exports completed plays, unwatched titles, favorites, watchlist changes, ratings, and dropped shows, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events. This is a separate plugin; reconnect each profile after installation. It does not restore legacy Trakt collections or home rows.
presentation.setup_markdown: Create an API app on the [Trakt developer portal](https://developer.trakt.tv/apps). If the app form asks for a redirect URI, use an HTTPS address you control; device-code sign-in does not use a redirect. Enter the Client ID below. Leave Client secret empty if Trakt did not issue one. Enable this plugin, then connect Trakt (Community) separately for each profile in watch-provider settings by entering the displayed code at trakt.tv/activate. Old official-plugin connections are not migrated.
